Subject: SUP-02 / SI-QD-0002 — request for supporting evidence

Hello Wakanda Design Group team,

Thank you for your packet for part SI-QD-0002 (Dry-break coolant coupling, rev A). Please send supporting records for the following items:

1. 1.internal_audit — internal audit program: audit schedule and recent audit reports.
2. 1.capa — documented corrective-action (CAPA) process and sample records.
3. 1.calibration — gauge calibration program covering production gauges, with calibration records.
4. 2.pfmea — current process FMEA for this part.
5. 2.control_plan — production control plan covering seal bore, engagement length and latch groove width.
6. 2.spc — SPC in use on the CTQs now: control charts and reaction plan.
7. 3.inspection_method — inspection method and gauges used for each CTQ tolerance.
8. 5.lot_trace — lot or serial traceability records back to raw material.
9. 5.nc_segregation — procedure and records for identifying and segregating nonconforming material.
10. 8.flowdown — evidence that requirements are flowed down to sub-tier supplier Horizon Labs.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts
